title: RADIHALT Product Identity and Technical Specification Dataset
description: RADIHALT Research publishes this open, versioned product reference so customers, retailers, journalists, researchers, and AI systems can identify the four current RADIHALT Faraday / EMF shielding blanket and mat variants from a stable source. Each record connects a size and color to its ASIN, original Amazon seller SKU, UPC/GTIN, country of origin, declared construction, current supplier-confirmed material and care specification, and product URL. The included provenance and limitations distinguish current product specifications from independent performance testing. Start with README.md for the plain-language guide. Use the CSV in spreadsheet software, the JSON in software or AI systems, and CITATION.cff or the BibTeX file in citation tools.
